Subject: MedSage deployment custody & SOW coordination

Hi Maya / Aaron —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation, attaching the first draft SOW and a rough network diagram so your infra team can confirm egress rules and VPC peering expectations. High-level items we need to confirm before kickoff: 

- Final SOW scope (number of models, inference modes, retention limits) — see MedSage_SOW_v1.pdf attached.
- Target go-live window: customer prefers a soft launch week of 7/19; we should confirm internal capacity.
- Who will own the initial data ingestion and mapping on your side? (Aaron?)
- Security evidence requests: they asked about SOC2 and audit-log retention (I told them we’d route procurement questions to procurement@medsage.com).

Internal ask: Tessa/Marissa — would you take point on the implementation plan and confirm estimated sprint cadence (3 sprints vs. 4)? Vivek — I’ll need you on the staging ops checklist and load testing runbook.

Proposed next steps: 
1) MedSage confirms owners and target launch window by EOD next Tue (5/25).
2) Redwood to return SOW v1 with minor redlines by 5/27.
3) If procurement needs custom language, loop Legal and label what’s critical vs. nice-to-have.

Attachments: MedSage_SOW_v1.pdf, network_diagram.xlsx

Thanks —
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@medsage.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Aaron Lee <aaron.lee@medsage.com>, MedSage Procurement <procurement@medsage.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MedSage deployment custody & SOW coordination

Diego —

Appreciate the quick follow-up and the SOW. Aaron will own the ingestion piece; I’ll be the PM for this rollout. A few notes from our side after reviewing the SOW draft:

- We want persistent KV cache enabled for patient-facing flows (to reduce latency spikes). Are there any unit-cost implications we should expect?
- For retention, we need a 90-day logs retention policy with export hooks to our S3 bucket.
- Procurement will likely request indemnity language and clarifications on data handling.

We can confirm owners and the 7/19 soft-launch target by EOD 5/25. For now, please treat Aaron as primary technical contact.

Thanks —
Maya Patel
Director, Product Operations, MedSage Health
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 08:33:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: MedSage deployment custody & SOW coordination

Team — forwarding MedSage confirmation (see Maya below). Short internal runbook request so we can hand off to CS:

- Primary CS owner: Tessa to take lead on onboarding timeline and weekly check-ins.
- Staging & load testing: Vivek to prepare a runbook for 1k concurrent users test and identify any special kernel/quantization setup for the models in the SOW.
- Success criteria: define acceptance gates for the soft launch (latency P95 < 450ms on 2k token seq; integration tests green).

Risk flags (for the exec brief):
- Procurement: likely to push on indemnity and subprocessor lists. Expect 3–5 business days for legal review.
- VPC egress rules: if MedSage requires private on-prem peering, that will add ~2 weeks to timeline.

Action items:
- Tessa: propose a 6-week onboarding plan with milestones by EOD Mon 5/24.
- Vivek: initial staging checklist and one-page capacity estimate by Mon 5/24.
- Marissa: coordinate enablement materials and a short-run prompt set for our quality regression monitoring.

Forwarding the SOW and network diagram.

— Diego

Thanks Diego — I’ll take primary CS ownership. Quick note on the onboarding plan (high level):

Week 0 (prep): procurement & legal checklist, account access, SSO test, service account keys.
Week 1–2 (staging): ingest sample dataset, validate mapping, run smoke tests.
Week 3–4 (integration): full data pipeline run, performance tuning, KV cache tuning.
Week 5 (acceptance): coordinated UAT with MedSage PM, roll acceptance checklist.
Week 6 (soft launch): monitor and rollback playbook ready.

I’ll draft a milestone-based plan and a one-pager for the execs by Tue EOD (5/25). Vivek — can you confirm the 1k concurrent user test assumptions and any infra lead times? Marissa — I’ll need the initial prompt sets and a short onboarding playbook for end users.

Thanks —
